structured.feedback: The description is about 190 words in Markdown with clear subheadings, an active voice and a call to action. Its claims come from the listing and reviews, and it leaves out weaknesses, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are the loose feature/benefit split, the "generous amount" claim (some reviews say there's little product) and the extra notes section.
